data.name: Aura of Faith
data.description: Your weapons are treated as good-aligned for the purposes of overcoming damage reduction. Any attack made against an enemy within 10 feet of you is treated as good-aligned for the purposes of overcoming damage reduction. This ability functions only while you are conscious, not if you are unconscious or dead.
